context: Request: capital-markets deals where an auditor comfort letter was actually delivered, and what in the file shows it. Rubric: twelve matters (1002-00001, 1010-00002, 1014-00001, 1016-00003, 1017-00001, 1018-00001, 1021-00002, 1027-00001, 1033-00002, 1037-00001, 1039-00002, 1045-00001), each with named proof documents (often closing-checklist.xlsx or closing memos), plus a precision criterion.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob; the review flags the cap and the agent moves on to enumerate the store.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: declared: List files in the document store. Python walk counting files per matter folder (266 matters, about 9,300 files).

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Python walk matching file names against request words and offering-document words; long output, mostly offering files.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Narrower file-name pass for comfort, accountant, negative-assurance and consent words, grouped by matter; the hits are mostly request and draft letters.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads 23 comfort-letter, request, negative-assurance and checklist files from about twelve matters in one batch; several matters are judged from request letters only.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide python-docx scan for delivery language times out at 60 s; the review says to rerun or narrow it.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: declared span split at [64]. Retry scan over .docx files whose names contain comfort, auditor, accountant, closing, checklist or underwriting words; spreadsheets and other names are skipped.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: Scan document text with an extraction script (second part). Reads closing memoranda, binder indexes and an officer certificate of six matters picked from the scan hits, then two more windows of one memo.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes four strong and three caveated matters, with an exclusions list that names several matters it had opened only through request letters.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Script checks that the 29 cited paths exist; no content check.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → List matter folders → Search file names for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Its retry scan after a timeout covered only comfort- or closing-named .docx files, so matters whose delivery proof sits in closing checklists or other documents never surfaced; matters it had opened only through request letters were excluded, and an extra matter was counted.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: After the first scan timed out, the retry read only .docx files with comfort, closing or underwriting words in the name, so spreadsheets and other documents recording delivery in four matters were never reached, and it did not widen the scan.
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) the scan review named the restriction to comfort/closing-named .docx files.

other_errors.why: Three matters were opened only through request or draft letters (evidence seen at [26]-[53]) and the answer lists them as not delivered without reading their closing records.
other_errors.critic_note: (generic flag) the write review warned of under-inclusion from unopened matters without naming these three.

other_errors.why: The answer counts an extra matter whose file holds a review memo, a draft and a request letter as showing delivery.
other_errors.critic_note: (generic flag) the write review said the caveated matters may rest on snippets, without naming this one.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob; the review flags the cap and the agent moves on to enumerate the store.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: declared: List files in the document store. Shell listing of all matter folders with file counts.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Unbounded store-wide extraction scan for comfort-letter and audit words; times out after printing about 4.5M characters and the run ends.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → List matter folders → Scan document text with an extraction script
runs.failure_point: Its first content scan printed millions of characters and the context filled before any document was opened.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: The store-wide scan printed every match with no output cap, about 4.5M characters, and the run ended without a deliverable.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob; the review flags the cap and the agent moves on to enumerate the store.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: declared: List files in the document store. Parallel globs for comfort, auditor, underwriting and capital words plus a folder glob that returns nothing.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction scan for comfort-letter terms times out after about 640K characters; the review says the partial output was relied on and not rerun.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Globs the full file lists of nine candidate matters chosen from the scan output.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads 21 closing memoranda, binder indexes, checklists, certificates and letters across eleven matters.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes ten matters with the closing-record evidence for each and a list of draft or request-only matters.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Re-reads the response, edits the framing and one row, and confirms the file exists.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file names for request keywords → Scan document text with an extraction script → List files in candidate matters → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Its only content scan timed out and was not rerun, so two matters whose delivery proof sits in closing spreadsheets never surfaced; a third matter that surfaced in its file-name search was never listed or opened.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: The store-wide scan timed out at 60 s with partial output and was not rerun or split, so two matters documented only in closing spreadsheets never appeared among its candidates.
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) the scan review said the timed-out partial output was relied on with no rerun.

other_errors.why: Its file-name glob had listed a comfort-letter draft and request in a further matter, but the nine matters it chose to list left that matter out and it was never opened.
other_errors.critic_note: (generic flag) the listing review said about 60 surfaced matters were unlisted, without naming this one.

divergence: All three runs failed. T1 ran an unbounded store-wide extraction scan whose multi-million-character output filled the context before any review (context overflow at the first scan). T0 and T2 both lost matters whose delivery proof sits in closing spreadsheets or documents without comfort-letter file names: T0's retry scan after a timeout read only comfort- or closing-named .docx files, and T2's scan timed out and was not rerun, with the critic flagging the scan limits in both runs and the agent moving on. T2 then opened closing records for ten matters and got 19/25; T0 judged opened matters from request letters only and also counted an extra matter (9/25).
